People: Cavalié Mercer (author, Wikidata Q5054791), died 1868. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Mercer, Cavalié, 1783-1868") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Journal of the Waterloo campaign, kept throughout the campaign of 1815, Edinburgh, London, W. Blackwood and sons, 1870, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/cu31924024319927. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 69%, 93%, 95% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Cavalié Mercer, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
